help.step_1: The Bioforest, Quarry and Ore Refinery produce automatically, even while your browser is closed, until storage is full. Upgrade all three to level 2 and claim the directive reward in Command.
help.step_2: Build Barracks and a Laboratory. Recruit Rangers; Barracks level 2 unlocks Sentinels and level 3 unlocks Assault Mechs. Tactics improves troop combat power, while Engineering improves production.
help.step_3: Select an outpost on the map. Neutral outpost defence is listed in reconnaissance. Their stocks regenerate by 1 unit per resource per minute, up to 400 × level; captured outposts do not regenerate stocks. Enemy players show their current defence in the mission dialog; plan for losses. Survivors and loot arrive only after the return journey. From Headquarters level 3 you can permanently capture free outposts. Captured outposts grant ranking points and 5 percentage points of additional resource production each.
help.step_4: The Citadel has 3,520 defence. Assemble a strong army and improve Tactics. Capture it to win the campaign. Afterwards, you can keep building and secure other free sectors.
help.step_5: All accounts share a world of 4,096 sectors. Player attacks, transport, alliances with diplomatic non-aggression pacts, world and private messages, and a player market are available. New accounts receive one hour of PvP protection. Live events and seasons are managed through world operations. Operator information and account security are in Account. Progress is stored by the server. The background worker processes the world even when your browser is closed.
